about_short_description.short_description: Emrgo is a financial technology company that provides infrastructure for capital markets activity focused on emerging markets.

product.name: Investment Banking & Markets
product.description: Provides financial advisory and capital raising services including debt and equity offerings, M&A advisory, and derivatives for emerging market clients.

product.name: Venture & Growth Banking
product.description: Supports fundraising for scale-up companies in emerging markets through equity, debt, credit, and Sukuk instruments.

product.name: Custody & Securities Services
product.description: Delivers custody, securities services, and brokerage solutions for private banks, asset managers, family offices, and broker-dealers in emerging markets.

product.name: Sales & Trading
product.description: Facilitates buying and selling of securities, including fixed income products, for clients across emerging markets.

product.name: Investment Advisory & Management
product.description: Offers strategic and financial advisory services including mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, and investment management for emerging market clients.

product.name: Islamic Expertise
product.description: Provides specialized financial solutions and advisory services compliant with Islamic finance principles for emerging market clients.
